bearer.description: Firebase ID token. Outside production, when Admin is unset: Bearer dev:<uid>.

planKey.description: Workspace commercial plan (pre-billing unlock). Enforced for team/member limits.

enabled.description: true = grant / keep entitlement; false = revoke

userId.description: Firebase UID or existing Neon user id

acceptPath.description: Relative path for the invitee to open after sign-in

member.description: Set when the invitee was added immediately (already a user)

emailSent.description: True when an invite email was sent via Resend for this response

emailError.description: Resend error message when emailSent is false after a send attempt

configured.description: True when a bot token or legacy Incoming Webhook is stored (secret never returned)

authMode.description: oauth | webhook when configured; null when disconnected

toolEnabled.description: Whether workspace tool entitlement addons.slack is enabled

isOverride.description: True when this team has an override (not using workspace default)
